title: PERS Alert Response Time by Contact
dataSources: Pendant alerts (`care:pendant`), medication adherence (`care:medication`), wandering alerts (`care:geofence`), check-ins (`care:checkin`), care-plan follow-up (`care:ops`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — PERS pendant alerts, medication blister-pack reminders, and wandering geofence signals — streamed to Splunk HEC via caregiver apps, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=care:pendant contact_name=* alert_epoch=* acknowledged_epoch=*
| eval lag_hours=round((acknowledged_epoch-alert_epoch)/3600,1)
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours, max(lag_hours) as worst_lag_hours by contact_name
| sort - avg_lag_hours
description: Measures alert response time by contact for PERS alerts.
value: Lag tracking shows which contact create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside PERS alerts.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `alert response time` on `care:pendant` events and aggregate them by `contact_name`.
visualization: Table of contact with average and worst alert response time.
grandmaExplanation: It measures how long things take for each contact so you can see where PERS alerts slows down.
